text: The dependency-analyzer's /src scan target does not exist as an absolute path; the actual source tree is at test-repo/src/ — osv-scanner commands using /src will fail with 'no such file or directory'.

When git rebase --continue fails with 'Committer identity unknown', set GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/EMAIL and GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL env vars for that invocation — git config is not writable in the agent environment.
